label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: E hicieron las piedras del shóham, rodeadas de engastes de oro, abiertas grabados de sello sobre nombres de hijos de Israel.
spanish: E hicieron las piedras del ónice, rodeadas de engastes de oro, grabadas de grabados de sello sobre nombres de hijos de Israel.
grammarChanges: shóham → ónice: הַשֹּׁהַם (H7718) is a common noun with the article, not a proper name; translated the lemma instead of leaving the transliteration, matching the existing rendering of the same lemma at 25:7 / 28:9 / 28:20 / 35:27.

abiertas → grabadas: מְפֻתָּחֹת is a pual passive participle (lemma 6605 b) from the same פתח root as the following construct noun פִּתּוּחֵי (lemma 6603, «grabados»); «abiertas» supplied the open-sense and broke the cognate pair, so the participle now shares the «grabar» root with «grabados» as the cited fail requires.

Added the linking preposition «de» between «grabadas» and «grabados de sello»: Spanish cannot juxtapose a participle directly against a following noun phrase, so the same linking «de» already supplied between «rodeadas» and «engastes de oro» (for the parallel hophal-participle + construct-noun juxtaposition מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת earlier in the verse) is extended to this second, identically-formed juxtaposition.
readerNote: Added «de» before «grabados de sello» to parallel the preposition already used for «rodeadas de engastes», since Spanish needs a linking word between a participle and its cognate noun that Hebrew juxtaposes without one.
